tools.name: conformance_check
tools.description: run one full client x IdP-shape conformance matrix (the POST /check operation; x402 $0.01 per check unless your account has an active Solo subscription/trial, metered exactly as REST)

tools.name: claim_trial
tools.description: claim the one-time free first Solo month for your first server (the POST /trial/claim operation; Bearer token required; EIP-191 proof required — first call the REST POST /trial/challenge, sign the returned message with your registered wallet, then pass nonce + signature here, exactly as REST)

tools.name: subscribe_solo

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: conformance_check, subscribe_solo · Private data: claim_trial, subscribe_solo, run_history, subscription_status · Public sink: conformance_check, claim_trial, subscribe_solo · Destructive: conformance_check, run_history.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: conformance_check, subscribe_solo · Private data: claim_trial, subscribe_solo, run_history, subscription_status · Public sink: conformance_check, claim_trial, subscribe_solo · Destructive: conformance_check, run_history

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
